svg.aria-label: Libraries I contribute to, and who uses them. 397M npm downloads a week combined. Effect, 71.0M a week, used by Cloudflare, Vercel, OpenRouter, OpenCode, T3 Code. Material UI, 14.9M a week, used by Netflix, NASA, Spotify, Amazon, Unity, Docker. React Native, 22.4M a week, used by Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, Shopify, Wix. Astro, 12.6M a week, used by Cloudflare, Microsoft, Google, IKEA, Porsche, Visa, OpenCode. Solid, 12.5M a week, used by OpenCode. React Hook Form, 67.9M a week, used by Grafana, Supabase, Cal.com, Elastic. tRPC, 8.6M a week, used by Netflix, Google, PayPal, Cal.com. Cheerio, 37.5M a week, used by Google, Microsoft, Elastic. Floating UI, 149.6M a week, used by Palantir, Microsoft, Grafana. 209 merged pull requests across 37 repositories with 773k stars between them: Effect (98 PRs), T3 Code (21 PRs), Material UI (10 PRs), React Native (2 PRs), bat (4 PRs), Astro (2 PRs), Synara (36 PRs), Solid (2 PRs), Slate (2 PRs), React Hook Form (1 PR), tRPC (1 PR), Floating UI (1 PR), Cheerio (1 PR), Immer (1 PR), oxc (1 PR), SwiftFormat (2 PRs), e2e (1 PR), Rolldown (1 PR), TanStack Virtual (1 PR), Vite+ (1 PR), Alchemy (3 PRs), tailwind-merge (1 PR), RHF Resolvers (1 PR), dom-expressions (2 PRs), distilled (1 PR), tsgo (1 PR), effect-form (1 PR), gqloom (1 PR), effect-start (1 PR), effect-boxes (1 PR), effect-units (1 PR), effect-attio (1 PR), effect-atom-svelte (1 PR), effect-bdd (1 PR), conform-to-effect (1 PR), eftar (1 PR), effect-avro (1 PR). Recent: Effect, Preserve OpenAI streamed refusal explanations; T3 Code, fix(server): RTF tracked deletions are left out of the extracted text; Material UI, [autocomplete] Respect readOnly when clearing on Escape; React Native, Sort URLSearchParams names by UTF-16 code units; bat, Keep configuration active for option-like filenames; Astro, Keep rewritten chunk entries out of the default sitemap; Synara, Show only installed providers in the model picker; Solid, fix(compiler,babel-plugin): keep non-ASCII whitespace in SSR option text. Security: 3 vulnerabilities reported in Effect, one high, one moderate and one low severity. 92% merge rate: 209 landed and 17 declined by maintainers. PRs I withdrew, PRs maintainers took over, and PRs closed in cleanups or rewrites are not counted as declined.
